equity.level_reason: Mammography percentages are reported and described by family income (67.7% to 81.5%), but values are only set side by side with no computed difference or ratio and no disparity framing.

level_alternative.reason: Family income is itself a social determinant and the gradient is described; a lenient reading of the SDOH-exposure rule could treat the described gradient as a level-3 contrast.
